decisions.decision: The Commission will have input into any further discussions about decorations that hinder cemetery maintenance, but the final decision rests with the DPW Director.
decisions.quote: it was determined that subjects such as this, do fall into the category of day-to-day maintenance and because of that, going forward, the commission will have input into any further discussions as it applies to decorations that hinder the maintenance of the cemeteries.
